source: 私有化批次 A/B 之后的产品面（产品身份 = glasspane-harness）

rules.why: the upstream npm package name is not installable as *this* product; a user following it gets opencode (@opencode-ai/* workspace scopes are kept bloodline)
platform packages are named after the product (product.json → platformPackage)
those endpoints belong to someone else's release; touching them is a push into a stranger's account
a user-facing string that says opencode is a product claim; internal identifiers are bloodline, strings are identity
a README line that says opencode must also say fork/upstream/anomalyco/MIT/上游/血缘
shipped code must not offer or link a first-party gateway this product has no account for
identifiers sent to third-party services must name this product, not upstream
never write a third party's $schema URL into a user's file
the user's own files are named for the product
an upstream tree this product deleted must not be referenced again

lineageNote: 2026-11-14: +2 in CHANGELOG.md [0.14.15] — the entry describes the two fixes shipped this round, one of which (installer-lineage) pins the banner's verbatim lineage line (an opencode fork — https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode); the CHANGELOG must quote that string to say what is now guarded, and names the packages/opencode/package.json path. Both are 'whose byte is this' attribution prose, not new product surface. Occurrences 9675 → 9677 over an unchanged 3355 files.
